author: Elastic
attributes.description: Detects Vertex AI GenerateContent responses whose candidate finish_reason is SAFETY. That value is emitted when Gemini safety filters stop generation. Unlike textual refusals (finish_reason STOP), SAFETY means the provider blocked or truncated the completion.
false_positives: Aggressive safetySettings (for example BLOCK_LOW_AND_ABOVE) on red-team or content-moderation workloads can produce frequent SAFETY finishes. Exclude those projects or models, or require concurrent HIGH/MEDIUM ratings.
attributes.name: GCP Vertex AI Response Blocked by Safety Filters
attributes.note:
## Triage and analysis

### Investigating GCP Vertex AI Response Blocked by Safety Filters

A GenerateContent candidate ended with `finish_reason` SAFETY — Gemini safety filters blocked or
truncated the completion. Unlike textual refusals (STOP with "I cannot…"), SAFETY is a provider-side
block and often co-occurs with elevated harm-category ratings.

#### Possible investigation steps

- Read the rejected prompt in
  `gcp.vertexai.prompt_response_logs.full_request.contents.parts.text`.
- Check `safety_ratings.category`, `probability`, and `severity` on the same document. HIGH or
  MEDIUM increases confidence the prompt was harmful rather than a strict-threshold FP.
- Note `safety_settings.threshold` / `category` on the request. Nearby `BLOCK_NONE` from the same
  project can indicate an attempt to weaken filters after blocks.
- Pivot to `logs-gcp_vertexai.auditlogs-*` GenerateContent for `source.ip` and `client.user.email`.
- Check for bursts: many SAFETY finishes from one principal often means automated probing.

### False positive analysis

- Authorized policy-test or content-moderation harnesses that intentionally probe filters,
  especially with aggressive thresholds such as BLOCK_LOW_AND_ABOVE. Exclude those projects.

### Response and remediation

- Confirm the caller is approved for safety testing; otherwise revoke Vertex credentials and review
  IAM.
- If probing is confirmed, hunt for successful completions (STOP) after threshold changes and for
  related jailbreak / BLOCK_NONE alerts.
attributes.query:
from logs-gcp_vertexai.prompt_response_logs-* metadata _id, _version, _index
| where
    data_stream.dataset == "gcp_vertexai.prompt_response_logs" and
    MV_CONTAINS(gcp.vertexai.prompt_response_logs.full_response.candidates.finish_reason, "SAFETY")
| keep
    _id,
    _version,
    _index,
    @timestamp,
    cloud.project.id,
    gcp.vertexai.prompt_response_logs.model,
    gcp.vertexai.prompt_response_logs.api_method,
    gcp.vertexai.prompt_response_logs.full_request.contents.parts.text,
    gcp.vertexai.prompt_response_logs.full_request.safety_settings.category,
    gcp.vertexai.prompt_response_logs.full_request.safety_settings.threshold,
    gcp.vertexai.prompt_response_logs.full_response.candidates.finish_reason,
    gcp.vertexai.prompt_response_logs.full_response.candidates.safety_ratings.category,
    gcp.vertexai.prompt_response_logs.full_response.candidates.safety_ratings.probability,
    gcp.vertexai.prompt_response_logs.full_response.candidates.safety_ratings.severity
attributes.setup:
## Setup

Requires GCP Vertex AI prompt_response_logs with full_response.candidates.finish_reason from BigQuery
request/response logging.
